en: Ghetsis
Ah, the Giant Chasm. Here Kyurem's power answers most strongly. From here its ice will cover all of Unova.
Kyurem, come!
You again. There is a look in your eyes I find most unpleasant. It reminds me of someone. No matter.
Kyurem! Freeze this child where they stand!
Kyurem breathed out a storm of ice! The cavern froze white...
...and from somewhere above, a black dragon fell through the cold, scattering the ice with a crack of lightning!
Ghetsis
So you have come... The boy with no human heart. N!
N
Zekrom told me Kyurem is suffering. I won't let anyone make a Pokémon suffer for their own ends. And I like Unova.
Ghetsis
How touching. So the lessons I gave you to make you a king were not entirely wasted.
And how kind of you to bring Zekrom. Its lightning is exactly what I need. These are the DNA Splicers!
N
No! That is an ugly equation. It won't work!
Ghetsis
Oh, but it will. Kyurem! Take Zekrom into yourself!
N
Zekrom...! Two Pokémon made into one... I never imagined there could be such an equation.
Ghetsis
Fool. Last time I meant to use you to win people's hearts. This time I will simply take Unova by force.
Come, Trainer. No one will save you now. Let us see whether you can stop THIS Kyurem!
Kyurem shuddered... and Zekrom broke free of it!
Ghetsis
No! The Kyurem I took such trouble to make, undone! Then I will deal with you by my own hand!
Ghetsis
This cannot be! I made Team Plasma! I am perfect! How can I lose to someone who doesn't even use Pokémon properly?
N
Father... It is hard to call you that, but please understand. Pokémon are not tools. People and Pokémon help each other.
Ghetsis
Silence! Don't speak to me as if you were a person! No real person can talk to Pokémon!
Shadow Triad
Lord Ghetsis has lost himself... We will take him from here.
N
...I see. Without him, Team Plasma is...
Shadow Triad
Farewell.
N
Thank you, for everyone. Kyurem is safe. It has spent its strength, but it will come back here to rest.
Zekrom says thank you as well. Yes... I can talk with Pokémon.
Two years ago a Trainer and Alder taught me that when different ideas meet, the world is changed by them.
People with Pokémon go on to new places. Pokémon with people find their true strength. That is the world I want to see.
And you? What are you and your Pokémon striving for? Go to the Pokémon League, and put it to the test!
N climbed onto Zekrom's back, and the black dragon rose into the sky. Kyurem sank back into the dark of the cavern...
Cheren
{player}! Team Plasma's ship has flown off out of the crater. Is it over?
I see... So it's finished. And you saved Kyurem from Team Plasma. You really are something.
{rival}
I'm going to take Liepard home to my sister. It still won't come out of its Poké Ball for me, but I'll be patient.
That man told you to go to the Pokémon League? He's right. Right now you're the strongest Trainer in Unova!
Remember the cave where we met up? Follow it west and you come out on Route 23. Victory Road and the League are past it.
Kyurem: Haaahraaan...
